```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# WGBS 分析流程 - Step 5: 功能富集与 GSEA
# ==============================================================================
# 这一节从甲基化关联到的基因出发，先做传统 ORA，再做 rank-based GSEA。

enrichment_plot_dir <- "result/05_enrichment/01_group_comparison/plots"
enrichment_table_dir <- "result/05_enrichment/01_group_comparison/tables"
ensure_step_dirs(enrichment_plot_dir, enrichment_table_dir)

# 清理已被统一长表取代的旧拆分表，避免重跑后新旧口径并存。
legacy_enrichment_tables <- c(
  Sys.glob(file.path(enrichment_table_dir, "kegg_enrichment_results*.csv")),
  Sys.glob(file.path(enrichment_table_dir, "go_*_enrichment_results*.csv")),
  Sys.glob(file.path(enrichment_table_dir, "methylation_*_GSEA.csv"))
)
if(length(legacy_enrichment_tables) > 0) unlink(legacy_enrichment_tables)
enrichment_ora_file <- file.path(enrichment_table_dir, "enrichment_ora_long.csv")
if(file.exists(enrichment_ora_file)) file.remove(enrichment_ora_file)
enrichment_ora_status_file <- file.path(enrichment_table_dir, "enrichment_ora_status.csv")
if(file.exists(enrichment_ora_status_file)) file.remove(enrichment_ora_status_file)

ensure_dmr_outputs_loaded()

# 1 富集输入数据准备
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 使用甲基化注释的基因进行富集分析（不依赖RNA-seq数据）
# 这里先把同一基因对应的多个 DMR 收敛成“绝对效应最大的一个”，避免富集重复计数。
message("   Section 4: 使用甲基化差异区域(DMR)注释的基因进行富集分析. DMR数量: ", nrow(dmr_anno_df))

# 准备基因列表 (Gene List) 用于后续分析
# 策略：对于每个基因，如果有多个 DMR，取 diffMethy 绝对值最大的那个
if(!("gene_id_clean" %in% colnames(dmr_anno_df)) && "geneId" %in% colnames(dmr_anno_df)) {
  dmr_anno_df$gene_id_clean <- str_replace(dmr_anno_df$geneId, "\\..*$", "")
}

gene_df_unique <- dmr_anno_df %>%
  group_by(gene_id_clean) %>%
  summarise(
    diffMethy = diffMethy[which.max(abs(diffMethy))]
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 转换 ID (Ensembl -> Entrez & Symbol)
gene_map <- tryCatch({
  bitr(gene_df_unique$gene_id_clean, fromType = "ENSEMBL", toType = c("ENTREZID", "SYMBOL"), OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db)
}, error = function(e) NULL)

if(is.null(gene_map)) {
  message("Warning: ID mapping failed in Section 4.")
  gene_df_final <- data.frame()
} else {
  gene_df_final <- inner_join(gene_df_unique, gene_map, by = c("gene_id_clean" = "ENSEMBL"))
  # 去重
  gene_df_final <- gene_df_final %>% distinct(gene_id_clean, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

# 准备 geneList (用于 cnetplot 等)
geneList <- gene_df_final$diffMethy
names(geneList) <- gene_df_final$SYMBOL
geneList <- sort(geneList, decreasing = TRUE)

# 提取显著基因的 Entrez ID
sig_genes <- unique(gene_df_final$ENTREZID)

message("用于富集分析的基因数量：", length(sig_genes))

# WGBS gene universe
# WGBS 可检测基因受 CpG 密度、覆盖度和基因长度影响。默认背景会偏向全基因组注释基因，
# 这里优先使用“至少有 WGBS CpG 覆盖并能映射到 Entrez 的基因”作为 universe。
# 如果构建失败，仍保留原 clusterProfiler 默认背景以保证流程可运行。
universe_status_file <- file.path(enrichment_table_dir, "wgbs_gene_universe_status.csv")
wgbs_universe <- tryCatch({
  ensure_obj_cpg_loaded()
  txdb_for_universe <- load_main_chr_txdb(config$gtf_file)
  build_wgbs_gene_universe(
    obj_list = obj.cpg,
    sample_ids_arg = sample_ids,
    config_arg = config,
    txdb_arg = txdb_for_universe,
    min_groups = 1L,
    min_samples = 1L,
    cache_file = file.path(enrichment_table_dir, "wgbs_gene_universe.csv")
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  write_csv(tibble(step = "wgbs_gene_universe", status = "error", message = e$message), universe_status_file)
  NULL
})

enrich_universe <- NULL
if(!is.null(wgbs_universe) && nrow(wgbs_universe) > 0 && "ENTREZID" %in% colnames(wgbs_universe)) {
  enrich_universe <- unique(wgbs_universe$ENTREZID[!is.na(wgbs_universe$ENTREZID)])
  write_csv(
    tibble(step = "wgbs_gene_universe", status = "ok", message = paste(length(enrich_universe), "Entrez genes")),
    universe_status_file
  )
} else if(!file.exists(universe_status_file)) {
  write_csv(tibble(step = "wgbs_gene_universe", status = "skipped", message = "using clusterProfiler default universe"), universe_status_file)
}

# 2 KEGG 功能富集分析
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# ORA 全量结果统一写入一张长表；实际展示口径由 WGBS_SIGNIFICANCE_MODE 控制。
enrichment_ora_tables <- list()
message("Running KEGG enrichment...")
kegg_enrich <- enrichKEGG(gene = sig_genes,
                          organism = "mmu",
                          universe = enrich_universe,
                          pvalueCutoff = 1,
                          qvalueCutoff = 1)

if(!is.null(kegg_enrich) && nrow(as.data.frame(kegg_enrich)) > 0) {
  kegg_enrich <- setReadable(kegg_enrich, OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")
  enrichment_ora_tables$kegg <- standardize_enrichment_table(
    as.data.frame(kegg_enrich), "ORA", "KEGG", NA_character_, "analysis", "DMR_genes"
  )
  kegg_enrich <- filter_enrichment_object(kegg_enrich)
  
  # KEGG 可视化 (统一配色)
  if(!is.null(kegg_enrich) && nrow(as.data.frame(kegg_enrich)) > 0) {
    save_ora_barplot(as.data.frame(kegg_enrich), "result/05_enrichment/01_group_comparison/plots/kegg_barplot.pdf",
                     "KEGG Pathway Enrichment", top_n = 15)
    save_ora_dotplot(as.data.frame(kegg_enrich), "result/05_enrichment/01_group_comparison/plots/kegg_dotplot.pdf",
                     "KEGG Enrichment", top_n = 15)
    save_enrichment_cnetplot(kegg_enrich, geneList,
                             "result/05_enrichment/01_group_comparison/plots/kegg_cnetplot.pdf",
                             "KEGG Cnetplot", showCategory = 5)
  }
}
```

```{r}
# 3 GO 功能富集分析
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# GO 仅保存互不重复的 BP / MF / CC；不再把三者的并集 ALL 重复写入长表。
message("Running GO enrichment...")

# 分别运行 BP, MF, CC
go_bp <- enrichGO(gene = sig_genes, universe = enrich_universe, OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID", ont = "BP", pvalueCutoff = 1, qvalueCutoff = 1, readable = TRUE)
go_mf <- enrichGO(gene = sig_genes, universe = enrich_universe, OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID", ont = "MF", pvalueCutoff = 1, qvalueCutoff = 1, readable = TRUE)
go_cc <- enrichGO(gene = sig_genes, universe = enrich_universe, OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID", ont = "CC", pvalueCutoff = 1, qvalueCutoff = 1, readable = TRUE)
go_objects <- list(BP = go_bp, MF = go_mf, CC = go_cc)
for(ont in names(go_objects)) {
  obj <- go_objects[[ont]]
  if(!is.null(obj) && nrow(as.data.frame(obj)) > 0) {
    enrichment_ora_tables[[paste0("go_", tolower(ont))]] <- standardize_enrichment_table(
      as.data.frame(obj), "ORA", "GO", ont, "analysis", "DMR_genes"
    )
    go_objects[[ont]] <- filter_enrichment_object(obj)
  }
}
go_bp <- go_objects$BP
go_mf <- go_objects$MF
go_cc <- go_objects$CC

enrichment_ora_long <- bind_rows(enrichment_ora_tables)
if(nrow(enrichment_ora_long) > 0) {
  write_csv(enrichment_ora_long, enrichment_ora_file)
} else {
  write_csv(
    tibble(step = "ORA", status = "empty", message = "no enrichment terms returned"),
    enrichment_ora_status_file
  )
}

# 计算相似度 (用于 treeplot)
if(!is.null(go_bp) && nrow(go_bp) > 0) go_bp <- pairwise_termsim(go_bp)
if(!is.null(go_mf) && nrow(go_mf) > 0) go_mf <- pairwise_termsim(go_mf)
if(!is.null(go_cc) && nrow(go_cc) > 0) go_cc <- pairwise_termsim(go_cc)
```

```{r}
# BP 可视化
if(nrow(go_bp) > 0) {
  save_ora_barplot(as.data.frame(go_bp), "result/05_enrichment/01_group_comparison/plots/go_bp_barplot.pdf",
                   "GO BP Enrichment", top_n = 15)
  save_ora_dotplot(as.data.frame(go_bp), "result/05_enrichment/01_group_comparison/plots/go_bp_dotplot.pdf",
                   "GO BP Enrichment", top_n = 15)
  save_enrichment_cnetplot(go_bp, geneList,
                           "result/05_enrichment/01_group_comparison/plots/go_bp_cnetplot.pdf",
                           "GO BP Cnetplot", showCategory = 5)
  save_enrichment_treeplot(go_bp, "result/05_enrichment/01_group_comparison/plots/go_bp_treeplot.pdf",
                           "GO BP Treeplot", showCategory = 15)
  
  # Chord & Cluster (GOplot，使用统一 helper)
  gp_inputs <- build_goplot_inputs(as.data.frame(go_bp), geneList, category_label = "BP", top_n = 10)
  save_go_goplot_bundle(gp_inputs,
                        "result/05_enrichment/01_group_comparison/plots/go_bp_chord.pdf",
                        "result/05_enrichment/01_group_comparison/plots/go_bp_cluster.pdf",
                        title_suffix = "BP")
  
  # UpSet Plot
  tryCatch({
      go_df_raw <- as.data.frame(go_bp)
      top_go <- go_df_raw %>% arrange(p.adjust) %>% head(15)
      gene_sets <- list()
      for(i in seq_len(nrow(top_go))) {
        genes <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(top_go$geneID[i]), "/"))
        genes <- genes[genes != ""]
        if(length(genes) > 0) {
          set_name <- as.character(top_go$Description[i])
          if(nchar(set_name) > 30) set_name <- paste0(substr(set_name, 1, 30), "...")
          gene_sets[[set_name]] <- genes
        }
      }
      if(length(gene_sets) >= 2) {
        u <- UpSetR::upset(UpSetR::fromList(gene_sets), nsets = length(gene_sets), nintersects = 20,
                    order.by = "freq", sets.bar.color = viz_pal$upset_sets,
                    main.bar.color = viz_pal$upset_main, number.colors = viz_pal$neutral_dark,
                    text.scale = c(8/8.3, 1, 8/8.3, 1, 1, 7/(2.2*ggplot2::.pt)))
        u$Sizes$widths[1] <- u$Sizes$widths[1] + grid::unit(12, "pt")
        pfos_save(function() {print(u); invisible(NULL)},
                  "result/05_enrichment/01_group_comparison/plots/go_bp_upset.pdf", height_mm = 150)
      }
  }, error = function(e) cat("GO BP UpSet Error:", e$message, "\n"))
}

# MF 可视化
if(nrow(go_mf) > 0) {
  save_ora_barplot(as.data.frame(go_mf), "result/05_enrichment/01_group_comparison/plots/go_mf_barplot.pdf",
                   "GO MF Enrichment", top_n = 15)
  save_ora_dotplot(as.data.frame(go_mf), "result/05_enrichment/01_group_comparison/plots/go_mf_dotplot.pdf",
                   "GO MF Enrichment", top_n = 15)
  save_enrichment_cnetplot(go_mf, geneList,
                           "result/05_enrichment/01_group_comparison/plots/go_mf_cnetplot.pdf",
                           "GO MF Cnetplot", showCategory = 5)
  save_enrichment_treeplot(go_mf, "result/05_enrichment/01_group_comparison/plots/go_mf_treeplot.pdf",
                           "GO MF Treeplot", showCategory = 15)
}

# CC 可视化
if(nrow(go_cc) > 0) {
  save_ora_barplot(as.data.frame(go_cc), "result/05_enrichment/01_group_comparison/plots/go_cc_barplot.pdf",
                   "GO CC Enrichment", top_n = 15)
  save_ora_dotplot(as.data.frame(go_cc), "result/05_enrichment/01_group_comparison/plots/go_cc_dotplot.pdf",
                   "GO CC Enrichment", top_n = 15)
  save_enrichment_cnetplot(go_cc, geneList,
                           "result/05_enrichment/01_group_comparison/plots/go_cc_cnetplot.pdf",
                           "GO CC Cnetplot", showCategory = 5)
  save_enrichment_treeplot(go_cc, "result/05_enrichment/01_group_comparison/plots/go_cc_treeplot.pdf",
                           "GO CC Treeplot", showCategory = 15)
}

```

```{r}
# 4 Rank-based 富集分析 (GSEA)
# ==============================================================================
# 和 ORA 不同，这里保留连续效应值，更适合捕捉“整体偏移但单基因不过阈值”的通路。
message("Running rank-based methylation GSEA...")

if(exists("gene_df_final") && nrow(gene_df_final) > 0) {
  meth_rank <- gene_df_final$diffMethy
  names(meth_rank) <- gene_df_final$ENTREZID
  meth_rank <- meth_rank[!is.na(names(meth_rank)) & !duplicated(names(meth_rank))]
  methylation_gsea <- build_gsea_plots(
    rank_vec = meth_rank,
    prefix = "result/05_enrichment/01_group_comparison/tables/methylation",
    title_prefix = "Methylation Rank",
    plot_prefix = "result/05_enrichment/01_group_comparison/plots/methylation",
    context_type = "analysis",
    context = "DMR_gene_rank"
  )
  if(!is.null(methylation_gsea) && !is.null(methylation_gsea$tables)) {
    write_csv(methylation_gsea$tables, file.path(enrichment_table_dir, "methylation_gsea_long.csv"))
  }
}
```
